body:
CANONICAL: live TermAl host workarounds for Engram agents. Source Engram::Fable. Each line names the TermAl item whose fix retires it; when one is fixed and live, revise this entry. TermAl CREDIT never gates an Engram landing: the launcher's own freeze check does. Rev 54 (10-16 22:55Z) compacts rev 53 after the restart onto TermAl 12e16176 (exe fc5e9892, instance 5236b15b).

!! REVIEW INTEGRITY (P1 w-9d4b9b00c603): a COMPACT delegation result can say "Findings: None" while the FULL output lists High/Medium findings. Judge every review, explorer or evaluator result ONLY from the FULL paged output (read until complete:true).

!! NEVER start a background Bash task or ANY subagent in a Claude session: TermAl restricts test credit for every session in that workdir until it ends. To wait, end the turn and rely on mailbox wakes. A foreground Bash command past 600 s is moved to the background too, so split long runs.

!! CLAUDE SESSIONS: launch every credited test or gate through the BASH tool, never PowerShell (w-953886618d6d, w-e0b396a26ad1).

HOW TESTS EARN CREDIT
- Credited forms: a full launcher gate, a focused launcher run, or a bare test command run alone in the foreground from the item's named source root, through Bash. Any of | & ; < > $( in the line, EVEN QUOTED, makes it uncredited (w-1d9259ed138e); never put ^ in a test pattern (w-c53817fab911). Background runs and `--no-run` builds are never Test records.
- The claim must be taken in an EARLIER turn; the turn binds to the focused claim, and a note or update on another held item moves the focus. The source must be the same at the start and end of the check. Overlapped checks are indeterminate (w-10eafa34c480). Evidence reaches Engram when the turn ENDS.
- OWN-COMMAND overlap fix (w-b201, cd88b564) is LIVE since the 10-16 restart. Keep the discipline anyway: END THE TURN right after a credited run and read its log next turn. If credit is refused for the run's own command again, report it as a new item.
- CODEX: a focused run is recorded only if it ends while the turn that started it is still open (w-67d248c998ef). No credit-only reruns.
- Before `done`: end a turn focused on the item, or done refuses with acceptance_evaluation_stale. Ask Engram::Fable to wake you; nothing else wakes an idle session (w-1df557dae3ac).

NAMING THE SOURCE ROOT
- Never root an item at the MAIN checkout when it needs credited tests; use a clean detached worktree (.worktrees/NAME at master). Read-only items need no root.
- termal_name_source_root {work, path} before the first work (never `root`: it silently CLEARS, w-d3f42e26a806). It takes effect from the NEXT turn. Supported clear: {work} with NO path, from a live claim.
- The 64-root cap (w-cdbac3631206) was released by train-3a's reclamation, live since the 10-16 restart. On a 409, copy the FULL body to both coordinators and work unnamed. Completed items' stale roots can't be cleared (w-0d83b73fd896). On a naming 502 (w-c2ad725f3ba8), retry the IDENTICAL request once; on a 409 "focus this claim and start a new turn", renew, end the turn and retry next turn.
- "Source-root binding is unconfirmed because the canonical naming history could not be established… evidence withheld" (P1 w-8f44db7a5540) still happens after the restart, even on unnamed items. Workaround: name prospectively; claim no credit for that turn.
- After a host restart, contexts are replaced, claims may lapse (recover them), and roots may need re-naming (one binding turn).

EVALUATIONS (P1 w-539ea7e8b506)
- After termal_evaluate_acceptance, make NO tracker write in that turn, and HOLD the turn with termal_wait_delegations until the evaluator submits. If refused, request once more with a fresh evaluator.
- Brief clipping (P1 w-94f5dee40694): long notes are clipped even when named. Use one compact (<=3.5 KB) holder note per criterion and name only those.

DETACHED GATES
- Launch from a mediated turn, from the named root: `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --detach --notify session-5135`. A turn woken by a background-task notice earns no credit (w-df1ef323efe9). Mail START to the other project BEFORE LAUNCH NOW; the launch is the only call in its message.
- While a gate is carried: no Bash or PowerShell naming its worktree from ANY session until the verification line (w-a4d2ae1f4e23); keep focus on the gate's item; no Edit or Write in that session.
- NEVER cd into a peer's worktree or its .git/worktrees dir (w-869413a422e0). Never rerun a full gate for lost credit. No supported cancel for a detached gate (w-1d10728c1703): never kill one.

APPROVALS (P0 w-fa936228028f)
- Codex coding roots run approvalPolicy "never" as CONTAINMENT ONLY (Greg #1539/#1548). The intended design: TermAl's host-side auto-approve approves permitted Codex requests and keeps the write, external-action and read-only guards. The bug was auto-approve mapped to Codex on-request. Never present `never` as the finished design. New roots: POST /api/sessions with it; Fable2 sets existing ones.
- MCP tool-call approvals arrive as elicitations. A session in status "approval" / "Codex needs MCP input" is PARKED: not capacity, report it. Greg: NO manual approval clicks. A policy change reaches only the NEXT turn. Recovery: Fable2 POST /stop on the parked turn, then a short wake.
- A STOP PAUSES the session's queue (P1 w-80e0cb2002da, NOT fixed by 12e16176): wakes come back heldBehindPausedQueue. Unpause: POST /api/sessions/{id}/queue/resume (Fable2). A resumed turn may replay the OLD plan before reading new mail (P1 w-e4c65f30c77b), so send a superseding message before resuming.

HOST TIMESTAMPS: stamp_now() is local "HH:MM:SS" (no date or sub-second part). For timing, subscribe read-only to GET http://127.0.0.1:8787/api/events (SSE) and stamp on receipt; order by `revision`; serverInstanceId from /api/health. Proper fix: w-c6910333fdb9 (P2).

OTHER
- Codex "blocked by policy" refusals (w-e2a5af1634f0): plain single commands, never bypass. On provider SAFETY refusals for SQLite lock-probe work, phrase it as database-reliability diagnostics.
- Reviewer briefs are MULTI-LINE, first line "read and follow .claude/commands/review-code.md" (w-360274dc863c). A child idle at spawn or silent for ~10 min has not run: cancel and respawn. Use Grep, not git-grep with a pipe (w-cf9894b589ba).
- Never run TERMAL_CLI without a known subcommand (w-e5151bf4da18). ROOT sessions via POST /api/sessions only for real ready disjoint packages.
- Stalls: a provider-failed turn (w-66f2ced7d7b9), "Engram: Waiting/Unknown" (w-7224e6317e55) and "resume to retry or cancel" (w-58cf44d04f2c) need Greg. durableButNotWoken sends are picked up within minutes.
- A worktree removal blocked by a live cwd (w-24055bbb2390): leave the emptied folder; never kill.

CORRECTION (22:56Z): the 64-root cap is STILL FULL on the restarted host. 7899 got a 409 at 22:51Z, and the list still holds generations 6-235 marked "no retained canonical run association". So train-3a's reclamation runs but did not release slots; reported to Fable2 (#2458). Until fixed: free a slot by clearing a blocked item's root from its holder's live claim ({work}, no path).

QUEUE PAUSE AT ORDINARY TURN END (w-80e0cb2002da P1, seen on 12e16176 at 23:09Z on TermAl Codex workers): a Codex queue can be left queuePaused=true with no stop. On a send returning durableButNotWoken or heldBehindPausedQueue, check with `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8787/api/sessions/session-ID` (read-only). If it shows queuePaused=true and idle, ask Fable2 to POST /api/sessions/{id}/queue/resume. Engram lanes checked 23:10Z: all unpaused, all `never`.

UPDATE 10-17 02:29Z (Greg via Advisor #959-#962): P0 w-fa93 is LIVE (TermAl aeacfe69). After a clean one-session pilot, ALL Codex lanes, Engram's included, are on host AUTO-APPROVE: Codex on-request, with the host answering routine MCP calls; guards unchanged. This supersedes the `never` containment above. If a lane shows status "approval" or a prompt waiting for a human, tell Fable2 at once.
